name: logging
description: Structured Elysia request logging with a per-request correlation id (x-request-id). Pretty in dev, JSON in production.
instructions: Every HTTP request is now logged as structured JSON with a correlation id.
Make a request and watch the API logs:  curl localhost:5002/health
Set LOG_LEVEL (debug|info|warn|error) in .env. Logs are pretty in dev and JSON when NODE_ENV=production.
Resolve the logger through the startup service registry when adding application-specific infrastructure.
